name: io.github.allooloo/getorderability
title: Allooloo Orderability
description: AIO orderability: may a capital product be ordered for a client category? Signed by the home node.

tools.name: get_orderability
tools.description: The AIO-10060 orderability outcome for one listed security and one client category of its home market's chapter: the router finds the issuer's home market by the subject, as for get_record, and that market's MCP produces it — one ACM-68000 signal where the evidence reaches it, or evidence_gaps with the pages checked and no signal; every element points at its chapter or record field; signed by the node (kid allooloo-eco-2026-10) and receipted at mcp.rco-records.ai with the node as writer.

subject.description: ISIN (best), ticker with exchange (TSX:SHOP, SHEL.L), LEI or CMR key.

client_category.description: One client category exactly as the market's chapter names it (the node door's /book/aio.json, client_categories).

tools.name: resolve_issuer
tools.description: Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI. The router names the issuer's home market and forwards to that market's MCP for the record summary.

identifier.description: Ticker with or without exchange (SHOP, TSX:SHOP, SHEL.L, BHP.AX, D05.SI, NESN.SW, SAP.DE, 7203.T, 005930.KS), ISIN, LEI, an exact legal name or a sourced alias.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Return the full issuer record, served by the MCP of the issuer's home market. The router stores no records.

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: The ACM-68000 signal for a listed security in its home market: ACM-200 TRADING (on the register), ACM-404 NOT ON THE REGISTER, ACM-451 READ THE FILING (a regulatory filing in the last three days, named). A bare ticker naming more than one issuer returns no signal but its candidates (add the exchange); a home market that does not answer returns an error, never a signal. ACM-000, ACM-300 and ACM-500 are reserved (ACM-68000 v1.1) and never served. ACM-403 HALTED is advisory: the markets carry no halt flag yet, so the answer links the market's halts page. Each signal has its page: https://acm-200.ai/, https://acm-403.ai/, https://acm-404.ai/, https://acm-451.ai/.

identifier.description: ISIN (best), ticker with exchange (TSX:SHOP, SHEL.L), LEI or CMR key.

tools.name: list_aliases
tools.description: Sourced trade and former names, served by the MCP of the issuer's home market.

tools.name: list_events_since
tools.description: Dated disclosure events for an issuer since a date, each with its source address, served by the MCP of the issuer's home market.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: Every market on the roster (nodes.json, with its region), which are live, and each market's MCP and agent card.
